name: Contact — UK helpline for parents and carers of disabled children
description: Contact's free information and advice helpline for parents and carers anywhere in the UK with a disabled child or young person up to age 25; a diagnosis is not required.
intended_use: Use when a parent or carer wants a human advice route about disability-related family support, benefits, education, social care or practical services.
audience_or_context: Parents and unpaid carers in any part of the UK with a disabled child or young person aged birth to 25.
limitations: This is a charity advice service, not emergency, safeguarding, legal representation or clinical care.
Opening hours, capacity and supported enquiry types can change; check the first-party page before relying on availability.
cost_or_access_notes: The helpline is described by Contact as free; other Contact activities may have separate conditions.
conflicts_of_interest: Contact is a charity campaigning for families with disabled children; ND Oracle records that advocacy role rather than presenting it as neutral state authority.
